LESSON: HADITH ON GOOD BEHAVIOUR

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Hadith on good Behaviour

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on good Behaviour. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should one behave well?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building
2. discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim
3. apply good behaviour in day-to-day life
4. appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by applying them in day-to- day life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HADITH ON GOOD BEHAVIOUR
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Hadith on good Behaviour helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: HADITH ON GOOD BEHAVIOUR
Study Hadith on good Behaviour like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building

What this means
In this part you learn to identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Hadith on good Behaviour” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim

What this means
In this part you learn to discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on good Behaviour in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Apply good behaviour in day-to-day life

What this means
In this part you learn to apply good behaviour in day-to-day life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply good behaviour in day-to-day life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply good behaviour in day-to-day life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by applying them in day-to- day life

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by applying them in day-to- day life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by applying them in day-to- day life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Hadith on good Behaviour” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by applying them in day-to- day life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Hadith on good Behaviour is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Hadith on good Behaviour” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Hadith on good Behaviour in your own words. (skill: discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: apply good behaviour in day-to-day life)

Example 4: Show how “Hadith on good Behaviour” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by applying them in day-to- day life)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Hadith on good Behaviour to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building.
3. Practise this skill: discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim.
4. Practise this skill: apply good behaviour in day-to-day life.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Hadith on good Behaviour from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on good Behaviour: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Hadith on good Behaviour?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should one behave well?
2. What actions show that you fear Allah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Hadith on good Behaviour means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify examples of good behaviour from the selected Hadith for character building.
5. Be able to: discuss the significance of the selected Hadith in shaping the character of a Muslim.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
